summary: Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, sophomore at a non-design US school, aspiring transfer to Köln International School of Design in Germany, interested in Integrated Design, philosophy enthusiast (Nietzsche, pragmatism, empiricism), self-taught in HTML, CSS, and Ruby, startup founder, experience in naming and branding, strong belief in the value of education and diverse knowledge, advocates for practical business models over ad-based revenue, interested in entrepreneurship and technology, enjoys biking and physical fitness, critical of traditional education systems, values creativity and innovation, engaged in online communities related to startups and design.
